title: Gospel of the Gutter
description: A low sawtooth bass forced through cycling vowel formants so it seems to talk, then scream. Over 16 cycles the vowels morph A-E-I-O-U while a rhythmic tremolo gate, FM grit and a band-pass sweep climb from a mumbled growl into a distorted shout.
code:
setcpm(124/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 c1 [c1 eb1] g0>*2").s("sawtooth")
    .vowel("<a e i o u a o u>/2")
    .ply("<1 2 1 4>/4")
    .fm(sine.slow(16).range(1, 9)).fmh("<1 1.5 2 0.5>/8")
    .vib("<3 5 7>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(13).range(0.1, 1.2))
    .bpf(sine.slow(24).range(220, 2600)).resonance(16).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(2).lpattack(0.005).lpdecay(0.12)
    .shape(sine.slow(32).range(0.15, 0.7)).crush("<16 12 8 6>/16")
    .tremolosync("<2 4 8>/4").tremolodepth(sine.slow(11).range(0.1, 0.8))
    .attack(0.004).decay(0.18).sustain(0.6).release(0.07)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.3, 0.7))
    .sometimesBy(0.12, x => x.speed(-1))
    .off(0.01, x => x.add(note(0.12)).gain(0.3))
    .room(0.2).gain(0.9)
)
